# Vendor Agreement — CloudScale Hosting Inc.

## Parties

This agreement is between Aurora Robotics Inc. ("Customer") and CloudScale Hosting Inc. ("Vendor"), for the provision of cloud infrastructure hosting services supporting Aurora Robotics' fleet management dashboard and related backend services.

## Term

This agreement was signed in January 2022 for an initial term of 3 years, expiring in January 2025. The agreement may be renewed by mutual written agreement of both parties no later than 60 days prior to expiration.

## Services

CloudScale Hosting Inc. provides virtual server infrastructure, managed database hosting, and content delivery network services used by Aurora Robotics' fleet management dashboard, the same system referenced in the March 2023 incident postmortem regarding database connection pool exhaustion.

## Fees

Aurora Robotics pays CloudScale Hosting Inc. an annual fee of $480,000, invoiced quarterly at $120,000 per quarter. Fees are subject to an annual increase of no more than 5%, as specified in Schedule B of the original agreement.

## Service Level Agreement

CloudScale Hosting Inc. guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime for all hosted infrastructure. In the event uptime falls below this threshold in a given calendar month, Aurora Robotics is entitled to service credits as defined in Schedule C, scaling with the severity of the shortfall.

## Termination

Either party may terminate this agreement with 90 days' written notice. Aurora Robotics may also terminate immediately for cause in the event of a material breach of the service level agreement that is not cured within 30 days of written notice.
